HUSCO provides individuals with the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast-paced, industry-leading and entrepreneurial organization.

Supplier payments for import and domestic purchases (creating payment proposal, uploading on the bank site, obtaining statutory forms from CA, completing formality in accordance with RBI guidelines) as per the payment cycle

B. Com

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

What role will you play?

We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented finance professional to join our Group Finance team. In this role, you will support global financial reporting, planning, and analysis activities, helping stakeholders make data-driven business decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Prepare and maintain monthly management reporting packages, including KPI reporting, variance analysis, and plan versus actual comparisons.
• Perform monthly actual-to-budget and actual-to-forecast analyses, identifying key business drivers and trends.
• Support the annual budgeting and forecasting processes, including data uploads, reconciliations, and review of financial assumptions.
• Ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data during month-end close activities and resolve data discrepancies.
• Develop, maintain, and improve reporting solutions.
• Extract, transform, validate, and analyze large datasets to support business and finance requirements.
• Build and maintain financial models to support planning, reporting, and business analysis activities.
• Collaborate with finance and operational teams across multiple countries and time zones.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to automate and enhance reporting processes.
• Respond to ad hoc financial analyses, management requests, and business inquiries.

About You

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• 2-5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Controlling, Financial Reporting, Business Finance, or similar analytical finance roles.
• Experience working within a multinational or shared services environment is preferred.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
• Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting.
• Working knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, and SQL.
• Familiarity with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle Hyperion, or similar platforms is an advantage.
• Good understanding of profit and loss statements and financial performance indicators.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
• Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across global teams.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Team-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement mentality.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting global or regional finance teams.
• Exposure to budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes.
• Knowledge of financial systems, reporting automation, and data visualization best practices.
• Progress toward professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, ACCA, or CPA is a plus.

Job Description

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Who are we?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

Role Summary/Purpose

The major responsibilities include budgeting, forecasting, reporting, analysing product cost and cost drivers on monthly/Quarterly basis. Annual set up of standard cost & maintaining necessary checks and balances in system to publish reports on time with high accuracy.

Responsibilities include overseeing and managing the monthly financial close process, strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting for the Freight sourcing business.

Candidate will also work very closely with Strategic Sourcing, Fulfilment, logistics, customs, Manufacturing operations to review each component of cost, understand driver for variances and participate in various cost out projects to drive productivity.

Essential Responsibilities

The Position demonstrates accountability for functional, business, and broad company objectives and will work closely with the Finance, Strategic sourcing, Manufacturing Operations & fulfilment Leaders in driving sound business analytics, business plans, product costing, and productivity analytics.
• Lead the preparation of STRAP, Annual Budget, Forecasts, and comprehensive variance analytics to support decision-making
• Manage the monthly financial close process, including reporting segment-wise financial performance and providing insightful commentary on deviations from Budget and Forecast.
• Developing accurate and predictable product cost forecasts with a deep understanding for the drivers behind variances (Material, logistics, customs, conversion cost). Keeping an eye on business dynamics which could impact forecast and highlighting potential risks / opportunities.
• Own the standard costing process for procured components, subassemblies, and manufactured products, ensuring robust analytics, periodic reviews, and compliance with SOX requirements
• Provide actionable cost insights and key financial inputs to cross-functional teams to support budgeting, strategic planning, cost optimization initiatives, and informed business decision-making
• Prepare and maintain cost records to comply with cost audit, statutory audit, and internal audits per companies act and group policies.
• Strong cost accounting and manufacturing background as understanding of costs and variances are key to the profitability of the Company.
• Closely working with logistics, Customs & sourcing team to develop tracker for forecasting / cost monitoring and cost outs, managing periodic rhythm with cross functional team and publishing reports to management.
• Ensuring compliance with corporate accounting policies, SOX, and unit specific internal controls. Close working with IT & controllership team for necessary system

Improvements, data hygiene & system automation.
• Closely working with Purchasing, logistics, Customs, Engineering and Manufacturing to understand root cause of all cost variances.
• Provide prompt support to auditors (Internal/External) to ensure timely completion of the audit report.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:
• CA/ICWA with 3–5-year experience or CA Inter/Bachelor’s/master’s degree in accounting, Finance with five to ten years of relevant experience.
• Strong knowledge of financial reporting and analysis, including proficiency with MS Office and accounting software (e.g., Oracle, Onestream, PowerBI, Excel, PowerPoint, Project)
• Detail oriented with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously

Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Additional Information

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Management Accounting (COE) team as part of our risk, reinsurance, and capital business at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune . This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Senior Specialist – Finance and Accounting (Grade C2)

This role supports annual statutory reporting and local compliance for multiple entities, including preparing statutory accounts, tax returns, and regulatory filings within deadlines. It involves coordinating with local controllers, statutory accounting teams, and auditors to complete templates, notes to accounts, and final signed reports. The role also ensures tracker discipline, documentation updates, and continuous process improvement across regions.

We will count on you to:

· Preparation and review of Annual Statutory accounts for entities as part of COE

· Time bound submissions of annual statutory accounts per the regulatory timelines

· Engaging with local controllers and statutory accounting team for creation of templates in Statutory reporting tool (Caseware / Workiva) and Notes to accounts before the due date of filing

· Audit support until signing of final statutory report

· Preparation of tax returns and other local compliances

· Adherence to operation tracker set for the team and ensure completeness with accuracy

· Providing assistance in filing of timely regulatory returns

· Adoption of best practices across regions and suggesting improvements to the process

· Preparation and maintaining the DPM.s (Process notes) upto date in the format adopted by AO

· Qualified CA with 2-3 years of experience in statutory accounting, taxation and finalization of accounts

· Strong commerce graduate with 6+ years of accounting experience in statutory accounting, taxation and finalization of accounts

· Sound knowledge of accounting principles and practices

· Prior experience in working in similar roles

What makes you stand out:

· Diploma in IFRS

Accountant

overview

About Mastercard
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven Accountant to lead and manage the accounting operations within our Global Business Solutions (GBS) organization. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of accounting activities, supporting both corporate and statutory reporting requirements.
This position primarily involves (but not limited to) managing Cash Accounting, Reconciliations and Month-end closing for Mastercard entities worldwide, and may further evolve for managing complex accounting with greater responsibilities.
This role involves collaboration with international stakeholders and various cross-functional teams to manage daily accounting operations, address queries, and implement continuous process improvements.

Roles & Responsibilities:
• Responsible for preparing and reviewing General Ledger reconciliations and journal entries as part of month-end close activities.
• Review Cash and sub-ledger transactions, perform foreign exchange (FX) analysis, and variance analysis to support accurate financial adjustments.
• Understand the financial impacts and intricate accounting treatments, ensuring strict compliance with regulations, laws, and reporting standards.
• Support reporting activities preparing various reports, scorecards and dashboards etc.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and handles process improvements, escalations, and BAU tasks.
• Support internal and external audits, including SOX compliance, and contribute to strengthening control frameworks
• Identify process gaps, assess and mitigate risks, and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
• Independently determines complexity of issues, escalates and makes recommendations to leadership.
• Support the business partner relationship and applies a client-service mentality by addressing ad-hoc requests and queries effectively.
• Manage special projects and initiatives, including entity transitions, process improvements, and new acquisitions.
• Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness.

All About You:
o Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; MBA, CA, CA Inter or equivalent certification preferred.
o 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 1 years in Cash accounting role.
o Strong understanding of subledger and controlling accounts for Cash, AP, AR, Intercompany etc
o Strong technical expertise in accounting operations, including GL management, reconciliations, and close processes.
o Fair knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, and statutory reporting requirements.
o Proficiency in Oracle systems is must
o Excellent verbal and written communication skills
o Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and learning agility
o Strong commitment to customer service excellence, featuring a customer-centric mindset
o Good understanding of MS Excel (Knowledge in PowerBI/Power Automate is beneficial)
o Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness
o Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

data.job_title: Senior Business Finance Analyst (Revenue Forecasting & Tracking)
data.job_description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

The Senior Business Finance Analyst is responsible for business performance analysis, reporting, and forecasting. Work with team on recognition and backlog reviews, and provides financial modeling, budgeting, and ad hoc analysis that feed long-term strategic planning and resource allocation.

How will you make an impact?

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant FP&A / business finance experience, ideally with exposure to revenue forecasting, tracking, or recognition.
• Strong Excel/Analytical skills (financial modeling, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
• Ability to work under pressure on multiple projects and deadlines.
• Ability to effectively prioritize workload and manage changes in the direction of the company.
• Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with all levels of employees and management to maximize performance.
• Ability to act and operate independently with minimal daily direction.
• Confidence to liaise and present to Senior Management.
• Desire to work in a matrixed environment.
• Accuracy and attention to detail.

Have you got what it takes?

• Intermediate skill level in MS Office applications.
• Experience with Power BI and Oracle.
• Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts (e.g. deferred revenue, backlog vs. recognized) in a subscription or services-based business.
• Prior technology industry experience.
• Revenue forecasting & tracking — own the revenue forecast / recognition and weekly close process. Track sales pipeline, bookings, revenue and renewals.
• Reporting & analysis — create meaningful ad-hoc and standard reports and refine existing ones. Each month, analyze actuals against forecast/budget and communicate weekly metrics, monthly results, and variance analysis, as well as quarterly and annual projections.
• Business partnering — act as a point of contact for the Revenue team and other stakeholders on financial modeling, budgeting, and business planning questions.
• Special projects — stay agile as new projects, initiatives, and opportunities arise — special projects are an opportunity to grow beyond the traditional analyst scope.
• Modeling — build models, from simple to sophisticated, from scratch, and improve existing ones. Creativity and new ideas are welcome.
• Data analysis — help the business understand, analyze, and draw conclusions from data to support decision-making.

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #LifeAtBNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager to join our Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) team within Finance. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

• Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.

• Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.

• Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.

• NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.

• Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.

• Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.

• Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.

• Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.

• Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

• Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.

• Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.

• Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.

• Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.

• Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.

• People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.
